Round 436 is implemented and ready for C; there is no STOP. All four of A's checks (A1–A4) passed. The browser rows, the full test suite and `npm run verify` were not run by me: they belong to C and the root gate.

**What changed (11 files, all on B's allowed list):**
- `strings.ts`: four labels change. The two "Source offset" texts become "Clip origin" / " · clip origin ", and "From, s" / "To, s" become "From" / "To".
- `ArrangementClip.tsx`: the move and trim status line now says "clip origin".
- 8 test files: only the expected strings in assertions changed (24 lines). No assertion was removed.
- New doc `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/283-studio-vis-4-6-detail-copy.md`. I wrote its line 4 as `**სტატუსი:** Completed (C round 436 PASS)`, the same format as docs 270–282. The task's wording omits the `**სტატუსი:**` prefix, so C should accept this form.
- The code change is exactly B's sketch: `git diff` equals it apart from `index` lines.

**Checks I ran:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| A1: sketch applies, diff equals sketch | PASS |
| A2: the 8 covering test files | 208/208 pass; slowest test 1766 ms against the 5000 ms default |
| A3: typecheck / lint | both rc 0; lint shows 205 warnings, the same count as B's run on the sketch (I did not lint HEAD myself) |
| A4: text sweeps | "source offset" 0 in the UI, "clip origin" 3; in tests, old strings 0, new 20 (matches B) |
| Biome on the 10 changed code files | rc 0, no fixes |
| Claims script | rc 0; differs from B's only in the expected K1, K2 (total 11) and K6 (doc 283 present) |
| Locked-file and protected-file lists | both rc 0; nothing outside the allowed paths changed |

**Code review:** the code-reviewer agent found no Critical, High, Medium or Low issues (score 9/10). It raised three info notes and no architecture note.

**Process gaps:**
- I applied the sketch with `git apply`, so the editor's primitives reminder did not fire for the code files. I read the mapped primitives afterwards; the change is text-only.
- The project's `/check` asks for `npm run verify` and the e2e smoke test. I ran the narrower checks the speed rules allow instead.

**Note for B:** the screen now says "clip origin" while the code still names it `sourceOffset`. One concept with two names goes against the agent-discoverable naming primitive. B ruled to keep the code names this round, so this is only a suggestion for a later rename or a glossary line.

**Still open:** the "From"/"To" visible text doesn't match the inputs' accessible names (TL-R436-03, deferred Low). The inline status text was not moved into `strings.ts` (TL-R436-02, deferred Low). Saba still hasn't answered Q4, whether the labels should show the unit.

**Next for C:** C1 (scope check), then the browser rows C3–C7 with `b-round-435/probe/copy-probe.mjs` against `http://127.0.0.1:5173` after the warm-up. Then C2 and C8–C14.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`; open `a-round-436.md` first. Logs are in `a-round-436/`.
